title: Deprecate Node
description: Retire a node by marking it deprecated and optionally naming a replacement.
signature: pub fn deprecate(&self, node: &mut Node, superseded_by: Option<Uuid>, actor: Actor, actor_name: &str, at: &str, reason: &str) -> Result<AuditRow>
semantics: Moves a node to Deprecated via write_transition, the alternative to deletion per PRD section 6.6.
